mapper.select: SELECT A.EMPLOYER_NO AS EMPLOYER_NO, B.MEMBERSHIP_NO AS MEMBERSHIP_NO, B.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE AS MEMBERSHIP_TYPE, B.MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE AS MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE, B.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE AS MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE, (TRUNC(B.MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE) - TRUNC(B.MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE)) AS REMAINING_DAYS, (SELECT C.MEMBERSHIP_NAME FROM MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL C WHERE C.MEMBERSHIP_NO = B.MEMBERSHIP_TYPE) AS MEMBERSHIP_NAME FROM EMPLOYER A JOIN MEMBERSHIP B ON A.EMPLOYER_NO = B.EMPLOYER_NO WHERE A.EMPLOYER_NO = #{employerNo} AND B.MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL = 'N'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_NO, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_PRODUCT, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_STATUS, MERCHANT_UID, IMP_UID ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAYMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, #{paymentProduct}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{merchantUid}, #{impUid} )
SELECT SEQ_PAYMENT_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP ( PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP_NO, MEMBERSHIP_NO, PAYMENT_NO, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAYMENT_MEMBERSHIP_NO.NEXTVAL, #{membershipNo}, #{paymentNo}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO MEMBERSHIP ( MEMBERSHIP_NO, MEMBERSHIP_TYPE, MEMBERSHIP_START_DATE, MEMBERSHIP_END_DATE, MEMBERSHIP_DEL_FL, EMPLOYER_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBERSHIP_NO.NEXTVAL, #{membershipType}, SYSDATE, CASE WHEN #{durationUnit} = 'MONTH' THEN ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, #{membershipDateValue}) WHEN #{durationUnit} = 'DAY' THEN SYSDATE + #{membershipDateValue} END, 'N', #{employerNo} )
SELECT SEQ_MEMBERSHIP_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
